agent_flags.summary: extra keys colliding with a first-class payload key (timestamp/level/logger/message) are silently dropped
agent_flags.rationale: First-class-wins is correct by design — a caller must not be able to forge a log line's level, logger or timestamp — and T-15's test now pins the precedence. A collision indicates a caller bug, so silence is acceptable; adding a warning would put a log call inside a log call.

agent_flags.summary: json.dumps(default=str) renders an unserialisable extra via str(), so an object repr containing secrets or PII could reach a log line
agent_flags.rationale: Not crashing the request path is the right priority, so the trade stands. The residual risk lands on future call sites: 13 consumer stories will add extra={...} calls, and per security-baseline the formatter offers them no protection. Needs a review/lint convention for what may be passed in extra= before those stories wire this up.

agent_flags.summary: rejected_value logs the raw, unbounded user-supplied query value — log-injection and volume-amplification vector
agent_flags.rationale: Accepted for fix in this session: cap rejected_value before logging. Keeps the PRD-mandated three-field set and TC-19 green while removing the unbounded-input vector; log injection was contained only incidentally by json.dumps escaping.

agent_flags.summary: no B/billions bucket — magnitudes above ~999,950,000 render as "1000.0M" and grow unbounded
agent_flags.rationale: Genuine product decision the agent correctly refused to invent on its own authority. Must be settled — B bucket, display cap, or accepted-as-is — before the first consumer story renders org-wide 12-month token totals, which can plausibly reach 1e9.

agent_flags.summary: guardrails-api defines pass = Enforced or Warning, contradicting D-05 / compute_guardrail_summary which counts Enforced only
agent_flags.rationale: Real cross-story contradiction, but guardrails-api is produced_by SHP-05 and is not BED-02's contract to change. Assigned to the SHP-05 owner: either align the pass definition with D-05 or state explicitly that the two rollups are distinct. Left unedited rather than forced into agreement, since which is right is a product question.

agent_flags.summary: TC-18 asserts the 2s NFR-002 budget but passes in under a millisecond — no route, no I/O, so it does not verify NFR-002
agent_flags.rationale: Cannot be closed inside BED-02: no production route is wired and nothing in the path touches Postgres.
